name: Updater Services Ltd
about: UDS offes integrated facilities management services and other services. Its service portfolio caters to the needs of diverse customer segments across a range of sectors including FMCG, manufacturing and engineering, banking, financial services, and insurance (BFSI), healthcare, information technology / information technology enabled services (IT / ITeS), automobiles, logistics and warehousing, airports, ports, infrastructure and retail, among others.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Updater Services Ltd (UDS), headquartered in Chennai, is India’s 2nd largest outsourced IFM player by market share. It has evolved into a diversified business services platform, offering IFM and Business Support Services (BSS), with a workforce of over 70,000 as of FY25.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 23.5% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 11.9% over last 3 years.
